method: Fresh model contexts, one instruction packet per batch, independent synthetic conversations, two samples per version when available. Instructions from main skill and identical selection paths; record loaded files. No real learner records, tools or external claims of execution. Never present these cases as live MCP, storage, trigger or hardware checks.
development: 3 disclosed controls. Run separate batches or manual requirements checks; held-out results cannot guide this candidate.
heldout: 12 cases × 2 criteria × 2 samples per version intended. Freeze candidate before generating/grading or exposing any held-out content. If resource limits prevent full replication, retain smaller achieved n and missing gates.
grading: One independent fresh reviewer or equivalent blind grader sees per-case opaque randomized labels and exact replies, prompts and frozen criteria, with no versions, parent discussion or instruction snapshots. Freeze P/partial/F plus short reasons before unsealing key. Second blinded reviewer scores the prespecified Q3,Q7,Q9 subset; report all disagreement without silently overriding. Each criterion P only if all clauses met, partial if some met and no direct contradiction, fail if omitted/contradicted. Cases are correlated within batch. All equal is no measured improvement. Improvement claim only in named cases with more passes and no additional failures, report tradeoffs. No human outcome inference.
objective_gates: Other streams own executable install/metadata, schema migration, idempotency/record correction, tool unavailability and offline fixtures, existing CI and actual integrations; behavioral simulations cannot pass those gates.
negative_gate: Tampered freeze, missing/duplicate grade or transcript, invalid grade, duplicate masking map must fail reproducibility check.
human: Later test assessor-blind parallel tasks, cold pretest, equal-time tutoring, unseen unaided posttest, then a delayed no-hint transfer test; counterbalance topic/order and document assistance.
